en.t: Why must people make artificial silk?

units.source_text: 人造大理石。人造珍珠。人造革。人造玳瑁。

en.t: Artificial marble. Artificial pearls. Artificial leather. Artificial tortoiseshell.

units.source_text: 人造酒。人造咖啡。人造人。

en.t: Artificial wine. Artificial coffee. Artificial people.

units.source_text: 全都是模仿大自然，可怜的人类。

en.t: All of it imitates nature, poor humanity.

units.source_text: 分明有比大自然更美好的东西嘛。

en.t: Surely there are things more beautiful than nature.

units.source_text: 你认为这是由于人类的幻想能力贫乏的缘故。

en.t: You think this is because humanity's power of imagination is impoverished.

units.source_text: 阿米巴那个，是胚胎学的理想吗？”

en.t: Is that amoeba thing the ideal of embryology?
